piezas.titulo: Speaking practice: Greetings and polite phrases
texto: Speaking and integrated interaction: when greeting someone in person, the cultural gesture of «ไหว้» (the wai: palms pressed together at chest or face level, with a slight bow of the head) is often used, especially when greeting elders or in formal settings. In spoken interaction, keep your pronunciation clear and steady on the long vowels of «สวัสดี» [sa-wat-dee], and get the tone of «ครับ» (high) and «ค่ะ» (falling) right.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การสนทนาอย่างสุภาพเปิดโอกาสให้เกิดมิตรภาพและความเข้าใจที่ดีต่อกัน» express?

opciones.texto: A polite conversation encourages friendship and mutual understanding.
